# GitHub Actions OIDC Trust Policy Checker

> Free tool: paste an AWS IAM role trust policy and see whether its GitHub Actions OIDC conditions actually restrict which repository, branch or environment can assume the role.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
